chapter_title: The Chapter on whether any [Lig]ht comes from the Three Vessels.
chapter_note: This chapter is almost entirely a compact cosmological-mechanistic exposition (light-rays entering via gates/doors, firmament-by-firmament clarification, division into an taken-up portion vs cast-down portion). The only clearly later material is the dialogue frame and question prompt in ¶1, plus the brief dialogue attribution introducing the teaching in ¶2.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Hagiographic/dialogue frame marker: "Once again the disciples questioned our enlightener. They say:" The content is a topic request rather than an expository mechanism; despite cosmological nouns (three vessels, universe), it functions as editorial framing.

paragraphs.core_text: [ ... ] b[u]t should the [ ... ] ascend [ ... ] light of the rays that [ ... ] which are received, which shine and go in through these great open gates, through these doors, firmament by firmament.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue attribution "The apostle s[a]ys to them:" (frame layer per extraction rules).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core mechanistic exposition (rays received; entering through gates/doors; ascent through firmaments) introduced by a Mani-compiler dialogue tag using "apostle" (frame), indicating an older teaching unit embedded in later attribution.

paragraphs.core_text: For four [gates o]pen in each world, distributed at the four points of the compass, opening downwards to the vessels. So, due to this, the [light of the] rays shall go in through these openings and it shines on [that] place, and pulls through them the light and the little pi[llar (?) that ex]ists there.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic cosmological architecture (four gates per world; four compass points; downward openings to the vessels) described in impersonal, structural voice; mapping stays within the cosmic system.

paragraphs.core_text: From that place [it] shall be poured [out to the] firmaments. It shall also be clarified in these firmaments [ ... ] a part there is cleansed and it is [all] taken up with the living ones. However, its other part [ ... ] shall all [be cast] down.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Process-description of purification/refinement across firmaments with a twofold sorting outcome (taken up with the living ones vs cast down). No citation, exhortation, or institutional anchoring; entirely mechanistic/cosmological.
